nodes.title: V2 Guides, Visible Ranges, Seams, Prompts, and Checkpoints
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3 segmented timeline V2

> **Workflow revision 2.0.2.** Lower resolution can shorten test iterations. When using an acceleration LoRA, match the sampling step count to that LoRA's intended schedule; the saved settings are an example, not a universal quality preset.

- Default: FL2VA weights, warmup_reset, 2.0 seconds, first_only, and original_image_reset. Every hidden warmup is cropped; retained task ranges remain contiguous and direct stitching adds no crossfade.
- Transition frame T belongs to the destination. warmup_reset generates destination-owned frame T after a source-conditioned hidden lead-in. first_last_bridge gives the A-owned task prompt A and a hidden B endpoint at T, then a separately warmed B-owned task begins at T with prompt B. hard_cut intentionally retains exact source B at T.
- String Multiline List supplies non-empty main prompts in image order. Missing prompt indices fall back to prompt 0; one line therefore owns every image. Prompt changes occur only between tasks.
- Technical Cut Instructions accepts a scalar string, String Multiline List string_list, or Wildcard Processor List list. Each non-empty list item is one complete direction; eligible intentional cuts consume them chronologically and cycle when needed. Inline wildcard syntax is also valid when expanded before the planner. Blank input uses the default camera-angle direction.
- Visual Conditioning Strength is shared by both task paths. Exactly 0.999 preserves ComfyUI's native H3 path by omitting the override. A value of 1.0 removes VisualVAE conditioning noise for the strongest anchor and may increase static behavior or reference-like flashes. Lower values add seeded VisualVAE noise and are not a direct motion control. Compare values only with identical inputs, seed, frame count, model, LoRA, and sampling settings.
- The Plan Step's start and endpoint indices are consumed inside Segmented Conditioning. FL2VA stretches a first image, center-cover-crops a last image, and creates minimax_keyframes. Ref2VA uses only the active original as persistent non-positional <Picture 1>, creates minimax_refs, and never exposes future images.
- FL2VA and Ref2VA are mutually exclusive checkpoint families. Selecting ref2va_active_reference requires matching Ref2VA diffusion weights; it supports warmup_reset only. Keep FL2VA weights for positional hard cuts and bridges.
- The Image Resize directly downstream of Image Selector normalizes the selected source batch without changing source files. To change final output size, resize the decoded, stitched frames before Save Video Data; this does not change planner timing or conditioning semantics.
- Hidden warmups, visible [start,end) ranges, technical seams, prompt owners, guide positions, and expected source ownership are serialized in analysis_manifest. Save that output as JSON for tools/analyze-minimax-h3-segmented-timeline-v2.py.
- Long intervals regenerate from their active original by default. plain_reset may visibly reset framing. intentional_camera_cut keeps the independent hidden reset but asks H3 for a clearly different angle/shot size at that same-image technical seam. generated_continuation instead aims for continuity with 22 generated frames but can accumulate drift. The editable cut instruction is applied only to eligible original-image technical reset tasks; transitions and bridges keep their normal prompts.
- The selected Load Audio excerpt defines MASTER_AUDIO_H3 and total_frames, remains connected to previews/final Save Video Data, and is muxed once after exact final trimming. The full generated song is saved before this excerpt is selected. H3-generated audio is discarded.

## Models used by this workflow

The saved graph enables **MiniMax Music 3**, **H3 FL2VA**, **Demucs vocals**, and **Wav2Vec activity analysis**. The **YuE2** music branch is included but muted. Enable one music generator at a time; if both are enabled, the selector gives YuE2 priority and both save branches can still execute.

### MiniMax H3 — video generation

| Component | Download | Folder under `ComfyUI/models/` |
|---|---|---|
| FL2VA diffusion model | [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) | `diffusion_models/` (the current installation also exposes `unet/`) |
| Text encoder | [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) | `text_encoders/` |
| Video VAE | [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors) | `vae/` |
| Audio guide VAE | [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) | `vae/` |
| Enabled 8-step acceleration LoRA | [minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) | `loras/minimax/` |

The graph selects `fl2va_keyframes`, this FL2VA LoRA at strength 1, and 8 sampling steps. Keep the checkpoint and conditioning family matched. The separate H3 audio VAE encodes the audio guide even though the workflow discards H3-generated audio and muxes the selected master excerpt into the final video.

---

### MiniMax Music 3 — full-song generation

The saved loader selects the local files `minimaxMusic_v30_fp32.safetensors` and `minimaxMusic_v30_txt_3107729.safetensors`, plus `minimax_music3_dav.safetensors`. Their model headers identify a Music3 FP32 diffusion model and BF16 text encoder. Official download names differ: select the actual downloaded filename in the loader on another installation.

| Component | Official download | Folder under `ComfyUI/models/` |
|---|---|---|
| FP32 diffusion model | [minimax_music3_dit_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_music3_dit_fp32.safetensors) | `diffusion_models/` |
| BF16 pruned text encoder | [minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/main/text_encoders/minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_bf16.safetensors) | `text_encoders/` |
| Audio VAE | [minimax_music3_dav.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_music3_dav.safetensors) | `vae/` |

Smaller alternatives, **not the currently selected files**: [FP16 diffusion](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_music3_dit_fp16.safetensors), [INT8 ConvRot diffusion](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_music3_dit_int8_convrot.safetensors), and [INT8 ConvRot pruned text encoder](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/main/text_encoders/minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors). Put them in the same component folders and change the loader selections explicitly.

---

### YuE2 — alternate music branch

- [yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/resolve/main/checkpoints/yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors) → `ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/`.
- This graph uses the checkpoint's baked CLIP and VAE. It does not use the Music3 text encoder or DAV for YuE2.
- ABC planning and music generation use the native YuE2 nodes. The saved duration cap is **360 seconds**; the generated duration drives latent length.

### Wav2Vec — activity analysis

- [wav2vec2_large_english_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/audio_encoders/wav2vec2_large_english_fp16.safetensors) → `ComfyUI/models/audio_encoders/`.
- Used by Audio Encoder → the H3 timeline planner to analyze activity and choose cuts. It is not a phoneme-to-mouth animation model.

### Hybrid Demucs — vocal separation

- The AudioSeparation node uses Torchaudio's [HDEMUCS_HIGH_MUSDB_PLUS](https://docs.pytorch.org/audio/stable/generated/torchaudio.pipelines.HDEMUCS_HIGH_MUSDB_PLUS.html), checkpoint `hdemucs_high_trained.pt`.
- Torchaudio downloads it automatically into the Torch Hub cache, normally `~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/`. It is not a ComfyUI `diffusion_models/` file.
- The vocal stem is used for activity analysis and H3 conditioning. Preserve its silent passages and duration; final playback uses the full-mix master excerpt.

### SmartLLM — caption, style and lyrics

- Selected model: [huihui_ai/qwen3.5-abliterated:9b-Claude](https://ollama.com/huihui_ai/qwen3.5-abliterated:9b-Claude), **Q4_K_M**, through Ollama.
- SmartLLM selector name: `huihui_ai-qwen3.5-abliterated-9b-Claude-Ollama`.
- Stored by the configured Ollama backend, not in `text_encoders/`. This is the prompt-writing model; it is separate from the H3 and Music3 text encoders.

---

### Save the song, review an excerpt, then render

Save Audio receives the full generated song before Load Audio. Load Audio currently selects **start 0 / duration 75.5 seconds**; its output defines `MASTER_AUDIO_H3` for planning, previews and final muxing. Incoming generated audio takes priority over the selected fallback file.

Enable **Stop (Result Review)** on Load Audio to audition before rendering; it is saved **off** here. Queue once for the full-source preview, adjust start/duration without queueing, then disable the stop and queue to release the excerpt. Keep upstream seeds and prompts unchanged to reuse available caches.

All download links above point to the corresponding publisher's repository or official bundle documentation. Different local filenames are documented as local selections, not as verified byte-identical mirrors.

Smaller alternatives, **not the currently selected files**: [FP16 diffusion](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_music3_dit_fp16.safetensors), [INT8 ConvRot diffusion](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_music3_dit_int8_convrot.safetensors), and [INT8 ConvRot pruned text encoder](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/main/text_encoders/minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors). Put them in the same component folders and change the loader selections explicitly.

---

### YuE2 — alternate music branch

- [yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/resolve/main/checkpoints/yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors) → `ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/`.
- This graph uses the checkpoint's baked CLIP and VAE. It does not use the Music3 text encoder or DAV for YuE2.
- ABC planning and music generation use the native YuE2 nodes. The saved duration cap is **360 seconds**; the generated duration drives latent length.

### Wav2Vec — activity analysis

- [wav2vec2_large_english_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/audio_encoders/wav2vec2_large_english_fp16.safetensors) → `ComfyUI/models/audio_encoders/`.
- Used by Audio Encoder → the H3 timeline planner to analyze activity and choose cuts. It is not a phoneme-to-mouth animation model.

### Hybrid Demucs — vocal separation

- The AudioSeparation node uses Torchaudio's [HDEMUCS_HIGH_MUSDB_PLUS](https://docs.pytorch.org/audio/stable/generated/torchaudio.pipelines.HDEMUCS_HIGH_MUSDB_PLUS.html), checkpoint `hdemucs_high_trained.pt`.
- Torchaudio downloads it automatically into the Torch Hub cache, normally `~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/`. It is not a ComfyUI `diffusion_models/` file.
- The vocal stem is used for activity analysis and H3 conditioning. Preserve its silent passages and duration; final playback uses the full-mix master excerpt.

### SmartLLM — caption, style and lyrics

- Selected model: [huihui_ai/qwen3.5-abliterated:9b-Claude](https://ollama.com/huihui_ai/qwen3.5-abliterated:9b-Claude), **Q4_K_M**, through Ollama.
- SmartLLM selector name: `huihui_ai-qwen3.5-abliterated-9b-Claude-Ollama`.
- Stored by the configured Ollama backend, not in `text_encoders/`. This is the prompt-writing model; it is separate from the H3 and Music3 text encoders.

---

### Save the song, review an excerpt, then render

Save Audio receives the full generated song before Load Audio. Load Audio currently selects **start 0 / duration 75.5 seconds**; its output defines `MASTER_AUDIO_H3` for planning, previews and final muxing. Incoming generated audio takes priority over the selected fallback file.

Enable **Stop (Result Review)** on Load Audio to audition before rendering; it is saved **off** here. Queue once for the full-source preview, adjust start/duration without queueing, then disable the stop and queue to release the excerpt. Keep upstream seeds and prompts unchanged to reuse available caches.

All download links above point to the corresponding publisher's repository or official bundle documentation. Different local filenames are documented as local selections, not as verified byte-identical mirrors.

widgets_values:
## MiniMax Music 3

A music generation model by MiniMax that creates complete songs up to 5 minutes long with stable structure and high audio quality. Two inputs drive it: **Caption** (structured music description: style, mood, vocals, arrangement) and **Lyrics** (with `[intro]` `[verse]` `[chorus]` `[bridge]` `[outro]` tags controlling song structure).

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| Caption | Music description. Write it in three sections — Global Metadata → Vocal Details → Arrangement. The more specific, the closer the result. |
| Lyrics | Song lyrics + section tags. Tags are the only executable structural instructions; the lyric text itself only conveys mood. |
| max_duration | Target song length in seconds (default 120 = 2 minutes; the model supports up to ~300 s / 5 minutes). Longer songs take more time and VRAM. |
| seed | Random seed for the generation. Keep it fixed to reproduce the same song; change it to get a different take. |
| Model files | diffusion model / text encoder / VAE.|
| Tiled decode | Decode the audio VAE in overlapping tiles to drastically cut VRAM usage — helpful for long songs on low-VRAM GPUs. Slightly slower, with a small risk of seams at tile boundaries; turn it off on high-VRAM GPUs for the best quality. |

### Prompt Writing Guide

You can find an official [Music Caption Rewriter Skill here](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3)

# YuE2 with SmartLLM

1. Edit the concept in **Smart LM Loader → user_prompt**. **YuE2** composes style and complete lyrics. The LLM selection, Training and generation settings match the MiniMax reference workflow.
2. For **Song Lyrics → YuE2**, enable multi-task mode, set task = Song Lyrics and task_2 = YuE2. Keep task_3 and task_4 = None. Structured sheets and supplied style/lyrics or caption/lyrics JSON automatically use conversion; lyrics are retained in code.
3. Loader text/result → Split YuE2 → style and lyrics on BOTH native generators. ABC notation is generated only by the native YuE2 planner.
4. Enable ABC planning = true plans melody and chords; false selects the empty score for direct generation. Leave both mode widgets on full, or set both to melody.
5. The saved max_duration cap is 360 seconds. It is a maximum, not a guaranteed song length. Generated duration sets latent length.
6. The Smart Model Loader supplies the shared seed to ABC planning, music generation and KSampler; the local 222 widgets are overridden by those links. INT8 checkpoint; 32 steps, CFG 1, dpm_2 / sgm_uniform; FLAC output.

Explicit instrumental requests allow empty lyrics with instrumental/no-vocals style. Instrumental audio quality remains unverified.

The original audio_yue2.json remains the native baseline.

nodes.title: Caption (ignored with Auto Prompt enabled)
widgets_values:
Global Metadata: Lo-fi hip-hop, chillhop. 78 BPM, D flat major, major scale with jazzy extensions. Laid-back and dreamy throughout, a gentle warm drift with a subtle late-night glow that deepens in the middle and dissolves softly at the end. Studying, raining-outside, headphones-on late-night listening. Bedroom production: muddy warm texture, heavy vinyl crackle, tape hiss and wow-flutter pitch wobble, low-passed dusty mix, soft-clipped drums, everything slightly detuned and cozy.

Vocal Details: Soft androgynous vocal, hushed half-sung half-spoken delivery, sitting low in the mix like another instrument, lazy behind-the-beat phrasing, gentle breathy timbre. Sparse murmured double-tracked harmonies, occasional wordless "mmm" and "ooh" hums drenched in tape delay and warm spring reverb. Long stretches with no vocals at all.

Arrangement: Dusty boom-bap drums with a soft thumping kick, cracked snare with lazy swing, brushed hi-hats, low round sub bass. Warm Rhodes piano chords with slow chorus wobble as the harmonic bed, mellow jazzy guitar licks answering the vocal lines, constant vinyl crackle as texture. Intro: rain and vinyl noise, solo Rhodes chords fading in, drums slipping in halfway. Verses: minimal — drums, bass, Rhodes, soft guitar fills between lines. Instrumental sections: guitar and Rhodes trade relaxed jazzy phrases over the beat, occasional muted trumpet ghost notes far in the background. Bridge: drums drop away to rain, crackle, and floating detuned Rhodes, then the beat eases back in. Outro: elements fade one by one until only vinyl crackle and a last unresolved Rhodes chord remain.

[Intro]
Mmm...
(rain on the window)
Ooh...

[Verse]
Midnight and the canvas glows
Dragging little wires where the current flows
Type a quiet dream, let the sampler drift
Noise into a picture, like the fog just lifts
Twenty slow steps, I'm in no hurry now
Latents turning colors and I don't know how
Every render's like a polaroid I found
Soft focus memories, no sound

[Instrumental]

[Verse]
Queue another frame, let the motion breathe
Pictures start to move like the falling leaves
Video drifting by at twenty-four
Little animations on my bedroom floor
Seed after seed like the rain outside

Save the ones that feel like a Sunday slow
Node to node to node... and off we go

Ooh... by the morning it'll all be done
(one more queue, one more try)

[Instrumental]

Rain keeps drawing pictures on the glass...
My machine keeps dreaming...
Neither of us fast...

[Chorus]
Mmm... let it render on
(take your time, take your time)
Ooh... by the morning it'll all be done
(one more queue, one more try)

[Instrumental]

[Outro]
Mmm...
(node to node)
Ooh... goodnight

widgets_values:
# H3 V4: lyric captions

## Audio and timing
Choose the song in **Full song source #196**. Auto prefers active generated audio (YuE2 before Music3); Selected file uses its file picker. That node stays at start 0 / duration 0 so alignment sees the full song.

**Shared clip start #197** drives both the H3 audio trim and captions. Set the clip length on **H3 clip #76**. Its actual returned duration also drives captions. Leave its source on Incoming audio. H3 planning, Wav2Vec, guide audio and clean playback continue to use the same trimmed MASTER_AUDIO_H3.

## Lyrics
Generator lyrics are taken from the same YuE2/Music3 selectors used for music generation, in the same priority order as audio. Leave **Manual full-song lyrics #200** empty for generated music. For a selected file, paste the matching complete lyrics there; nonempty manual text takes priority. Do not use unrelated active generator lyrics for a loaded recording.

## Render and save
The background comes from **Final Exact Timeline Trim #140**, after the complete stitch loop. Width/height come from these actual frames; FPS comes from FPS_H3. The floating-word appearance, font, colors and glow are copied from Audio_YuE2_Captions. No second image resize is applied.

**Enable lyric captions #210** mutes/unmutes the renderer. With captions muted, the mixed switch saves the clean H3 frames with the same trimmed master audio. Use Mute rather than Bypass. Final files use the H3 output folder and the MiniMaxH3_LipSync_V4_Captions prefix. The former metadata saver #136 remains available, muted, for a separate clean export.

## Review and optional vocals
Expand Report, SRT, Timing JSON and Cleaned lyrics beneath the renderer. SRT is clip-relative; timing JSON refers to the complete source song. The existing unmatched-passages=transcribe option can add recognized wording in unmatched gaps; review those additions.

The optional **full-song Demucs #205** is muted initially; captions analyze the full mix. Enable it if vocal isolation helps. Do not connect H3's already-trimmed vocals to the full-song caption input.

Paste corrected full-song JSON into **#206**, then connect it to corrected_timing. It must match this full song and lyric text. It is intentionally empty and disconnected; timing from the YuE2 example was not copied.

## Linked audition and metadata export
Editing **Shared clip start #197** or connected numeric duration controls immediately updates the available audio preview without queueing. Playback restarts at the new excerpt and keeps its playing/paused state. Computed trim values are marked as requiring execution.

**Saver #208** now uses Save Video with Generation Data. Caption VIDEO keeps its soundtrack, dimensions, FPS and duration; the clean IMAGE fallback uses the existing audio, FPS and trim settings. CRF, preset and filename connections remain in place. Use the feature chips for workflow embedding and JSON sidecars; connect a Generation Data PIPE for A1111 parameters and generation placeholders. **Optional clean exporter #136** stays muted.

## Exact temporary timeline variant

Decoded retained pixels are stored in execution-local NumPy chunks, in their original dtype. Full accumulated previews stream every chunk. Captions and clean saves read exact pixels, never preview MP4s. Budget roughly 30 GiB of temporary disk for four minutes at 512×896/24 fps float32. Files follow cached timeline ownership; this is not restart recovery. A zero-extension plan saves the base timeline. Restart ComfyUI after installing the Eclipse update.
